upstreamLock.contractReview: 2026-11-15: newly published native Decision V4 runtime, image/video assets, questions, limits, response and lazy auth ported with all portable exact-release test scenarios. Preserved existing video surface; JS-only workflow/file-union exclusions and native token counter adaptation documented in package integration metadata.

scenarios.upstreamScenario: sends one native request with all question types and configured headers
maps answers and preserves confidence, legends, warnings, usage and response metadata
sends file parts as ordered image and video assets and keeps text and JSON in state
rejects invalid provider limits before HTTP
accepts the maximum question count and a single-level score
warns about unsupported settings without adding fields to the request
preserves HeyGen error codes and parameters
loads environment authentication lazily and uses the default endpoint
rejects inline text files before HTTP
scenarios.reason: Swift AIDecisionFileData has no inline text-file case; this invalid JS-only union shape cannot compile. Regular state text remains supported and exact file/media rejection tests are ported.

scenarios.upstreamScenario: rejects references without a HeyGen asset before HTTP
scenarios.reason: Swift AIDecisionFileData.reference takes the current provider-native String, not a namespaced map; other-provider-map shape cannot compile. Valid asset String behavior is tested for both images and video.

scenarios.upstreamScenario: restores the endpoint and authentication across workflow serialization
scenarios.reason: JavaScript Workflow serialization symbols/fetch restoration have no Swift runtime surface.

testDispositions.note: Preserve existing video aliases, explicit/environment auth, custom endpoints/headers, unsupported families. Refresh exact lazy missing-credential video-status scenario and add provider specificationVersion assertion.

testDispositions.reason: JavaScript Zod constructor laziness and module-import instrumentation do not exist in Swift runtime; native validation performs no JS schema construction.

testDispositions.note: No video-body or response behavior changed by 3.0.25 Decision addition; retain every existing translated video scenario and rerun full owning suite. Shared lazy headers are tested on actual video status and rotating start requests.

release.notes: Add HeyGen multimodal Decision V4 with boolean/choice/score questions, ordered image/video assets, limits, confidence/JSON score legends/answer warnings and usage. Credential loading now occurs at request time for Decision and video; preserve the existing throwing initializer and video selectors. Published 3.0.25 test scenarios are translated; JS workflow and impossible invalid file-union shapes excluded explicitly. No paid/live-service claim.
release.compatibility: Additive Decision APIs/capability. Missing credentials are reported on a request rather than factory initialization, aligning published upstream timing; existing throwing initializer signatures retained.
